attempts.raw: {"text": "I’m so sorry about the red scarf," Jamie said, holding up the torn fabric. "I didn’t mean to ruin it. I just needed something warm and grabbed it without asking." Alex looked at the damage, then sighed. "Next time, just ask. It’s not just about the scarf—it’s about respect." A pause. Then Jamie nodded. "You’re right. But let’s not replace it. We can mend it. I’ll use my grandmother’s needle and thread. It’ll be a reminder to ask next time. And maybe even stronger than before. We can mend it—really, we can mend it.""}
